name: Mast Room
summary: Timber from Westfall reaches the Mast Room, deep in the Deadmines, where goblin woodcarvers shape it for the Defias.

sections.title: The Underground Sawmill
sections.body: The Mast Room turns timber from Westfall into parts for a warship. Deep in the Deadmines, the cavern holds felled logs, sawdust, and great cutting machines. Goblin woodcarvers shape the masts, ribs, and planks needed for the vessel hidden farther within Ironclad Cove. Sneed watches over their work as the Defias Brotherhood makes the wood serve its war.

sections.title: Industrial Labor
sections.body: Sneed directs the goblin woodcarvers from atop a mechanical shredder. Logs rise and pass through the planers in a steady flow, while the workers meet his demanding quotas. The old gold mine now rings with the labor of a shipyard, where timber becomes the pieces of a vessel.

faq.q: Why is there a lumber mill inside an underground mine?
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood is secretly building a great warship in the cove beneath the mines. The Mast Room shapes its masts, framing, and hull planks from timber smuggled in from Westfall.
Sneed runs the Mast Room, directing goblin woodcarvers from a lethal mechanical lumber shredder.

faq.q: Why are goblins working here for the Defias?
faq.answer: Edwin VanCleef hired goblin engineers and craftsmen for expertise human stonemasons lacked. In return for gold and profit, the goblins bring heavy machinery, explosives, and shipwright skills.

angles.text: Sneed's goblin shredder uses crude steam-and-cog machinery, adapted from forest logging to crush intruders.
Timber from this chamber shows that Defias pillaging across Westfall serves a coordinated industrial effort.
